AMBULANSYANG NAPARA NG DOTR-SAICT, GINAGAMIT NA SHUTTLE SERVICE 

Ambulansyang napara ng DOTR-SAICT dahil sa hindi awtorisadong pagdaan sa EDSA Busway Santolan station, natuklasang ginagamit bilang shuttle service.  

Bumungad sa mga operatiba ang loob ng isang ambulansya na puno ng mga upuan na katulad ng makikita sa ordinaryong shuttle van o pampasaherong sasakyan, at walang anumang kagamitan para sa mga medical emergency tulad ng stretcher, oxygen tank, o iba pang first-aid equipment.  

Nang tanungin ni Special Operations Group (SOG) Head Rayson Dela Torre ang isa sa mga driver tungkol sa kawalan ng karaniwang medical equipment sa loob ng ambulansya, diretso nitong sinabi na ginagamit nila ito bilang service vehicle para sa mga pasaherong magpapa-check up lamang sa ospital.  

Binigyan ng Temporary Operators Permit (TOP) ang mga driver ng nasabing ambulansiya, dahil sa mga natuklasang violations.  

Kabilang sa mga nakuhang violation ang Disregarding Traffic Sign (DTS) o illegally passing through EDSA Busway at Failure to Carry OR/CR dahil hindi maipakita ng driver ang orihinal na kopya ng Official Receipt/Certificate of Registration nang mapara ito. | via Luisito Santos,DZBB/GMA Integrated News  

COURTESY: Screengrab from DOTR-SAICT's video

data.raw_text:
RE: THE INCIDENT ALONG EDSA NORTHBOUND

We really need to review our police traffic procedures to avoid absurd results. How can there be "Reckless Imprudence Resulting to Homicide" if the ultimate fact is that the person fell from the sky?

Any lawyer worth his salt would agree that no amount of due diligence could have prevented that type of incident.

Depriving a clearly innocent person of liberty under the guise of standard procedure is contrary to the tenets of justice. The NAPOLCOM and the PNP have already initiated a study of traffic procedures with the aim of implementing necessary reforms.

#NAPOLCOM
#PulisNgPulis
